metadata.chunk_title: Online Master of Science in Materials Science and Engineering + Prepare for a career in materials science and engineering

facts.value: Employers across the public and private sectors seek graduates with a background in materials science and engineering. Upon completion, you can pursue roles in fieldwork, research, development and more. Plus, a graduate degree is often required for senior, managerial and other advanced roles.
